small_guidance:
- The current kernel iterates IC inside a triple KD/KH/KW loop with one program per output element and BLOCK_OC=64; this serializes 32 IC × 27 kernel taps × 64 OC FMAs per program. Switch the inner work to a `tl.dot`: load a `[BLOCK_IC, BLOCK_OC]` weight tile and a `[1, BLOCK_IC]` (or `[BLOCK_SP, BLOCK_IC]`) input tile per (kd,kh,kw) and accumulate via matmul; bump `num_warps` to 4 and keep `num_stages=2`.
- Tile multiple output spatial positions per program (e.g. BLOCK_OW=8 along contiguous W) so the IC reduction and weight loads are amortized across 8 outputs, and so the softmax-over-OC at the end runs on a `[BLOCK_OW, OC]` tile in registers.
- Add a `triton.autotune` over `{(BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_IC, BLOCK_OW)} = {(64,16,4),(64,32,4),(64,16,8),(64,32,8)}` with `num_warps∈{4,8}`, keyed on `(OC, OD*OH*OW, IC*KD*KH*KW)`.
large_guidance:
- Restructure as a gather-style implicit GEMM: for each output tile `(N, OC_tile, OD*OH*OW tile)`, reduce over the K dimension `IC*KD*KH*KW` using `tl.dot`. Index math maps each (kd,kh,kw,ic) K-slot to an input (id_,ih_,iw_) with the standard transposed-conv divisibility/bounds mask; load the masked input column as a `[BLOCK_K, BLOCK_SP]` tile and the weight as `[BLOCK_K, BLOCK_OC]` (weight pre-permuted to `(KD,KH,KW,IC,OC)` contiguous on OC). This gives real tensor-core throughput instead of scalar FMAs.
- Since OC=64 fits in a single tile, make the kernel persistent over the full OC axis per output spatial tile so the softmax+sigmoid epilogue happens in registers without a second pass — accumulate the full `[BLOCK_SP, 64]` output, then do row-wise max/exp/sum/sigmoid and store. This keeps the fused softmax cheap and avoids any intermediate write of the conv output.
- Use channels-last-ish layout for the weight (`(KD*KH*KW*IC, OC)`) prepared once in `__init__`/first forward, and keep input as `(N, IC, D, H, W)` with the gather reading IC contiguously per (id_,ih_,iw_); coalesces the K-dim loads. Stride/padding/output_padding handling stays in the index math, masking the K lanes whose (id_,ih_,iw_) fall outside the input.
